For reusing a tag I've already used, Version A — the inline one where I start typing and my existing tag ("Recipes," marked "Used before") comes up to pick — feels the most natural. That typing-and-it-suggests behavior is exactly what keeps me from accidentally making "recipe" and "recipes" as two different tags. Version C's popover did the same thing and would be fine too; Version B just laid the tags out as chips to click, which is pleasant but I'd want the type-to-find as the collection grows. So A is my pick.

Your placement and framing are right: tags sitting beneath each bookmark is where I'd look for them, and yes — Recipes, Research, and Design are the kind of tags I'd have used before and want offered back to me.
